items.title: Home Screen with Search
items.description: The Home screen displays a search box that navigates to the Search page when submitted.

covers.text: R1: The Home page has a search box; submitting it shows the Search page with the results.
Searches, opens products and saves them.

tests.behaviour: type 'flour' into the search box and submit
click on a product from search results
tests.expect: Product Detail screen for that product

items.title: Product Detail Page
items.description: The Product Detail page displays all required fields including name, brand, category, certification, ingredients and a Save button.

covers.text: One product: name, brand, category, certification, ingredients and a Save button.
Name, brand, category, certification, ingredients, short description
Which stores carry it
R4: The Product page shows the product's name, brand, category, certification and ingredients from its record.

tests.expect: Product name, brand, category, certification and ingredients displayed

tests.behaviour: click the Save button when not signed in

steps.title: Saved Items Functionality, Stores: remaining requirements

items.title: Saved Items Functionality
items.description: Users can save products from the Product Detail page and view them on the Saved screen.

covers.text: Searches and opens products; saving asks them to sign in (one tap in the prototype).

tests.behaviour: save a product from Product Detail page
click Save button without being signed in

items.description: Every requirement below from "Stores" works in the app.

steps.title: Home Screen Implementation, Search Screen Functionality

items.title: Home Screen Implementation
items.description: Display the app's purpose, search functionality, ZIP code input, category navigation, and featured products.

covers.text: What Clean Cart is in one line, a search box, and a few featured products.

items.title: Search Screen Functionality
items.description: Enable searching across product names and brands with case-insensitive matching.

covers.text: Results for a search across product names and brands; a clear no-results message.
R2: Search matches product names and brands, case-insensitively ("oat" finds "Oat Milk Original").
R3: A search with no match says so and suggests trying another word.

steps.title: Save Product Button, Saved Products List, Persistent Saved Products

items.title: Save Product Button
items.description: A signed-in member can save and unsave a product from its detail page.

covers.text: R5: The Product page has a Save button; a signed-in member's Save adds the product to Saved, and pressing it again removes it.

tests.behaviour: click Save button on Product Detail screen
click Save button again on same product

items.title: Saved Products List
items.description: The Saved screen displays all saved products with name and brand, each opening its product page.

covers.text: The products the member saved, each opening its product page.
R6: The Saved page lists the saved products by name and brand; each opens its Product page.

tests.behaviour: visit Saved screen with saved products
tests.expect: list of saved products with name and brand

tests.behaviour: click on a saved product in the list
tests.expect: navigate to Product Detail screen for that product

items.title: Persistent Saved Products
items.description: Saved products remain saved after page reload using browser storage.

covers.text: R7: Saved products are still saved after the page is reloaded (kept in this browser).

tests.behaviour: save a product and reload the page
tests.expect: product remains in Saved list after reload
previously saved products are still in Saved list

items.title: Design polish
items.description: Polish the whole app as one product, to the standard of a studio portfolio, without changing what it does (follow the art-direction skill and the concept the screens were designed to, then the design-system and micro-feedback skills).

items.title: Clean up the code
items.description: Remove what the build left behind, without changing what the app does or how it looks.

steps.title: Assemble the app: wire every page and component into App.tsx

items.title: Assemble the app: wire every page and component into App.tsx
items.description: Finish the app in src/App.tsx: every screen that was built is in the app shell's navigation and shown once in its main area (never the same screen twice), each component that was created is used inside its screen so nothing is left unused, and no starter or placeholder text remains.
